rawBlockNode.name: secC1T
rawBlockNode.content: Our technology delivers mobility, adaptive intelligence and resilient communications for security missions. Always-on solutions can be rapidly deployed or withdrawn, ensuring uptime demands of covert and sensitive missions.

rawBlockNode.name: secC2T
rawBlockNode.content: Our security-grade mobile satellite network provides in-demand connections to remote and challenging border environments while maintaining command continuity and response capabilities with full mission videos and data transmission.

rawBlockNode.name: emC1T
rawBlockNode.content: Kymeta technology provides emergency responders with flexible, resilient communications in crisis situations. Our network offerings, terminal and services solutions offer an adaptable, easy-to-deploy communications environment when in extreme need. This robust communication infrastructure supports first responders, enhancing their ability to coordinate lifesaving efforts and improve emergency response effectiveness.

rawBlockNode.name: emC2T
rawBlockNode.content: In times of fire and crisis, Kymeta is ready to deploy terminals offer firefighters and command centers with minimal power requirements. Our technology provides exceptional high-volume data transfer and low-latency sharing and voice communication to enhance situational awareness and firefighting capabilities, even in the most demanding environments.

rawBlockNode.name: secDesc
rawBlockNode.content: Kymeta provides robust hybrid connectivity and real-time command insight for defense missions, border security and intelligence operations. Our adaptive solutions ensure critical data and communication remain secure and accessible in dynamic situations.

rawBlockNode.name: emDesc
rawBlockNode.content: Kymeta empowers emergency responders with resilient access to easy-to-deploy solutions during crises. Our rapidly adaptive network and communications solutions enable front-line teams and command center operations with continuous situational awareness and response effectiveness.

rawBlockNode.name: sec1desc
rawBlockNode.content: Kymeta is changing the way the world connects. Kymeta offers the first electronically scanning, flat-panel satellite terminal for fixed and mobile platforms. Combined with our global, high-bandwidth services and world class support, we offer a complete connectivity solution so you can stay connected wherever in the world you go.

children.name: p1desc
children.content: The Kymeta Osprey is all-purpose defense and government operation with resilient, integrated, and always-connected communications-on-the-move capabilities.

children.name: p2desc
children.content: Able to switch dynamically between LEO, GEO and cellular networks, this turnkey satellite user terminal offers enterprise uptime, robust and durable hardware suitable for security and intelligence agencies.

children.name: p3desc
children.content: Stay connected even in rough conditions on the open ocean. Instant waterway, or more flow. The Peregrine u8 seamlessly integrates with your vessel's IT infrastructure.

children.name: acc1Desc
children.content: Hard-shell cases with tie-down points safely and securely transport terminal systems. Rugged construction ensures reliable protection during transport.

children.name: acc2Desc
children.content: Mounting systems attach terminal hardware to poles, roof racks, and marine vessels so equipment is secured for stationary or on-the-move operation.

children.name: acc3Desc
children.content: AC and DC power kits include everything needed to connect terminal systems to vehicle or building power infrastructure.

children.name: yearDesc
children.content: Physicist Victor Veselago, Ph.D., publishes an analysis stating that materials could be created to have both negative permittivity and permeability. This theoretical material does not exist in nature, but Veselago's research shows the remarkable properties such a material would possess.

children.content: We are united by a common vision and key values, informed by shared principles that guide our work today and into the future.
Securing the future with revolutionary technology.
Leveraging our disruptive technology, we deliver intelligent communication platforms that empower resilient connectivity and spatial intelligence, anytime and anywhere.

Kymeta's core principles define the character and spirit of our employees and focus our experts. We are committed to fostering a workplace rooted in trust by creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment that is rooted in accountability, employee well-being and corporate social responsibility.
We deliver solutions that delight our customers

children.name: secC1T
children.content: Our technology delivers mobility, adaptive intelligence and resilient communications for security missions. Always-on solutions can be rapidly deployed or withdrawn, ensuring uptime demands of covert and sensitive missions.

children.name: secC2T
children.content: Our security-grade mobile satellite network provides in-demand connections to remote and challenging border environments while maintaining command continuity and response capabilities with full mission videos and data transmission.

children.name: emC1T
children.content: Kymeta technology provides emergency responders with flexible, resilient communications in crisis situations. Our network offerings, terminal and services solutions offer an adaptable, easy-to-deploy communications environment when in extreme need. This robust communication infrastructure supports first responders, enhancing their ability to coordinate lifesaving efforts and improve emergency response effectiveness.

children.name: emC2T
children.content: In times of fire and crisis, Kymeta is ready to deploy terminals offer firefighters and command centers with minimal power requirements. Our technology provides exceptional high-volume data transfer and low-latency sharing and voice communication to enhance situational awareness and firefighting capabilities, even in the most demanding environments.

children.name: secDesc
children.content: Kymeta provides robust hybrid connectivity and real-time command insight for defense missions, border security and intelligence operations. Our adaptive solutions ensure critical data and communication remain secure and accessible in dynamic situations.

children.name: emDesc
children.content: Kymeta empowers emergency responders with resilient access to easy-to-deploy solutions during crises. Our rapidly adaptive network and communications solutions enable front-line teams and command center operations with continuous situational awareness and response effectiveness.

children.name: r1d
children.content: Empowering defense and government operators with resilient, fully-integrated Multi-Orbit and Multi-Network connectivity in an easy-to-use terminal. Built to MIL-STD with embedded A-PNT and GNSS-denied capabilities.

children.name: r2d
children.content: Able to switch dynamically between LEO, GEO and cellular networks, this turnkey terminal easily integrates with existing systems. Robust and durable hardware suitable for security and intelligence agencies.

children.name: c1t
children.content: Kymeta Osprey™ u8: Mission-Ready Multi-Orbit Terminal

children.name: c1d
children.content: The Kymeta Osprey™ u8 – hybrid-GEO-LEO and bundled services is the first truly turnkey solution developed for military and government users to take full advantage of multi-orbit and multi...

children.name: c2t
children.content: The Kymeta Osprey™ u8 Advancing On-The-Move

children.name: heroTitle
children.content: Durable user terminals for mission-critical operations

children.name: sec1desc
children.content: Kymeta is changing the way the world connects. Kymeta offers the first electronically scanning, flat-panel satellite terminal for fixed and mobile platforms. Combined with our global, high-bandwidth services and world class support, we offer a complete connectivity solution so you can stay connected wherever in the world you go.

children.name: p1desc
children.content: The Kymeta Osprey is all-purpose defense and government operation with resilient, integrated, and always-connected communications-on-the-move capabilities.

children.name: p2desc
children.content: Able to switch dynamically between LEO, GEO and cellular networks, this turnkey satellite user terminal offers enterprise uptime, robust and durable hardware suitable for security and intelligence agencies.

children.name: p3desc
children.content: Stay connected even in rough conditions on the open ocean. Instant waterway, or more flow. The Peregrine u8 seamlessly integrates with your vessel's IT infrastructure.

children.name: acc1Desc
children.content: Hard-shell cases with tie-down points safely and securely transport terminal systems. Rugged construction ensures reliable protection during transport.

children.name: acc2Desc
children.content: Mounting systems attach terminal hardware to poles, roof racks, and marine vessels so equipment is secured for stationary or on-the-move operation.

children.name: acc3Desc
children.content: AC and DC power kits include everything needed to connect terminal systems to vehicle or building power infrastructure.
